method: For each of 59 exact native term IDs, follow outer type-11 terms pointer backward to a two-option pointer list. Follow each pointer to a 0x96/0x0f inner typed record; decode affix_desc variant, max_val, min_val, and affix_ids backward typed array. Preserve float precision and offsets; 12 options point to the native empty affix object.
interpretation_gate: This is an available source term definition table, not a selected or owned calibration roll. The join from a correction-print style/weapon/tier to a term ID and the draw/weight semantics remain unproven. Type-11 affix_desc pointer targets are retained raw; their localized template binding has not been decoded. Numeric ranges are source min/max fields, not promised attainable roll probabilities.
